name: Writing Guidelines
summary: Review docs and prose for the Vercel writing handbook's rules on voice, structure, lists, code and typography, in the terse file:line format. OpenRA-adapted carry of the vercel-labs skill: the rules are vendored from vercel-labs/writing-guidelines at a pinned commit instead of fetched from its mutable main branch at review time; the recorded differences are in PROVENANCE.md inside the skill.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 按 Vercel 写作手册审查文档与行文：语气、结构、列表、代码与排版规则，以 file:line 简报输出。vercel-labs 技能的 OpenRA 适配携带：规则自 vercel-labs/writing-guidelines 钉住 commit 本地携带，替代审阅时从可变 main 分支拉取；差异记录在技能内 PROVENANCE.md。

permissionsNote: allowed-tools declarations inside SKILL.md are upstream claims, not host approvals; OpenRA enforces its own permission gates.
